title: Fairness Agents in Scientific Collaboration: A Research Agenda

contributions.purpose: 提出并形式化'Fairness Agent'概念及其角色类型学
contributions.mechanism: 基于约 40 篇种子文献的雪球式综述,定义嵌入科研工作流的公平监测智能体,分 Observer/Interventionist/Reflective 三型
contributions.evaluation: 纯概念构建,自承未经实证验证;类型学以 Table 1 形式给出
contributions.domain: AI fairness x 多智能体系统 x 科学社会学(概念性)
contributions.source_quote: This paper introduces the concept of Fairness Agents: autonomous software agents embedded in scientific workflows to detect, explain, and mitigate bias in collaborative knowledge production.

contributions.purpose: 给出 Fairness Agent 的功能架构与应用场景
contributions.mechanism: 三层架构(交互层记录/数据层审计/治理层规则),配跨学科健康研究、同行评审、开放科学三个用例
contributions.evaluation: 仅列表式描述,各节内容极简(每节 1-3 行),无原型无仿真
contributions.source_quote: Drawing on a structured literature synthesis, we define Fairness Agents, propose a typology (observer, interventionist, and reflective agents), and outline a functional architecture. We illustrate their relevance through use cases in interdisciplinary research, peer review, and open science.

contributions.purpose: 识别关键设计挑战并给出研究议程
contributions.mechanism: 指出信任与透明、公平规范冲突(equity vs meritocracy)、bias-by-design 三大挑战,提出仿真/参与式设计/评估准则三条未来方向
contributions.source_quote: The paper concludes by discussing key design challenges - transparency, trust, and norm conflict - and proposes directions for future evaluation and participatory co-design.

self_declared_provenance.quote: We identify a research gap at the intersection of multi-agent systems, epistemic justice, and AI fairness.
This paper extends the fairness discourse from predictive models to the social and epistemic infrastructures of science.

notes: 概念性 research agenda(非实证),协议适配一般:evaluation 格全为定性/无验证,正文自承'this work is not empirically validated'。质量问题:Results 各节(typology/architecture/use cases)仅几行列表,近空壳;章节编号错乱('4 2 Typology of Fairness Agents''5 3 Functional Architecture');References 作为编号章节 9 出现。AI 自我披露:AI Involvement checklist 承认偶发幻觉/不精确引用、复杂文献浅层综合、相邻概念混淆;写作主要由 AI 完成,人类仅补小节标题并注明'this division was too difficult for the AI'(分析[D],假设/设计/写作[C])。Paper checklist 后半 6 项全答 NA 且理由雷同('conceptual paper'),Code of ethics 答 NA 属答非所问。贡献列表以 conclusion 'Our contributions include' 3 条为准。
